name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Adds native and combined Continue sections, per-user recent music sections backed by a ten-second listening threshold, Recently Added per-library sections, uncropped Book and Audiobook art with author labels, music-specific Media Bar slides, native section-order reconciliation, correct media-only library expansion, and a Main Top Row with uniquely targeted page/library overrides and library-scoped Genres in a Row.
